_comment: Per-host identity, read by the app (src/data/brands.ts) and by Node (scripts/build-assets.mjs, scripts/build-hosts.mjs). One source. Colours were read off the organiser's own badge (public/brand/foodera/logo.png once they send the file); every text/ground pair is annotated with its contrast ratio.

foodera-expo.contrast: checked by scripts/check-brand-contrast.mjs — every text/ground pair ≥ 4.5:1

palette._markNote: graphic only: 4.12 on paper, 2.52 on the host ground -> on dark the square is drawn white and the diamond gold-soft (BrandMark tone rules)
